title: House jobs this weekend (21–22 Nov 2026)
body:
This weekend's house jobs from my open home todos, most urgent first.

- [ ] Call the plumber about the boiler (high, due today): [[call-the-plumber-about-the-boiler]]
- [ ] Clear the gutters (medium, due today): [[clear-the-gutters]]
- [ ] Fix the broken fence panel (medium, due Mon 24 Nov; materials receipt in [[2026-10-21-08-52]]): [[fix-the-broken-fence-panel]]
- [ ] Plant the tulip bulbs before the first frost: [[plant-the-tulip-bulbs-before-the-first-frost-move-the-rosema]]
- [ ] Move the rosemary somewhere sunnier: [[plant-the-tulip-bulbs-before-the-first-frost-move-the-rosema]]

## Unsure

- Not house jobs, so left off the list, but they're open for this weekend: [[renew-car-insurance]] (high, overdue since 19 Nov), [[camping-kit-for-the-weekend]] (stove and gas, head torches, first aid kit still to pack) and [[buy-dog-food]] (low).

## Status check, Sat 21 Nov

Nothing ticked off yet: all five jobs are still open, here and in their own todos.

### Findings
- Due today: [[call-the-plumber-about-the-boiler]] (high), [[clear-the-gutters]] (medium)
- Due Mon 24 Nov: [[fix-the-broken-fence-panel]] (medium; receipt in [[2026-10-21-08-52]])
- No due date: tulips and rosemary, [[plant-the-tulip-bulbs-before-the-first-frost-move-the-rosema]]; it's a note, not a todo, and the tulips need to go in before the first frost
- Not house jobs: [[renew-car-insurance]] is overdue since 19 Nov (high); [[camping-kit-for-the-weekend]] is 2/5 packed (stove and gas, head torches, first aid kit to go)

### Open questions
- [ ] Tulips/rosemary has no todo of its own, so it won't show up in todo searches. Make it one?
